statement: Kernel wired IBEX registration first requests string attribute using feature1 command payload [0xae, 0x15, 0x01], expects same command header, a valid attribute ID and a bounded string length; if failure/empty, uses internal fallback without blocking. It then requests attributes [0x83, 0x00], parses 5-byte tagged attributes from valid reply, logs failure but continues registration. Serial/attribute values are No evidence and are not represented as physical fixtures. hid-steam.c:667-717,1372-1411,1770-1822. USB feature2 GET wireless state is conditional on WIRELESS quirk only; it is not sent by direct 1302 wired probe (720-743,1795-1804).

applicability.scope: Wired USB 28de:1302; host-side source parsing / host commands only, no live or physical validation. Refer to docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md C6 section.
